connectFirst: Connect to the radio to see this.
newNodes.title: New nodes
newNodes.oldFirmware: This radio's firmware keeps every new node or none; update it to choose kinds and distance.
tidy.title: Tidy up
tidy.note: Favourites, yours and chats stay. Runs while this app is connected to the radio.
memory.title: Memory
star.bodyOne: The radio replaces any contact without a star, even one you write to or sign in to. A star keeps {name} on it.
star.bodyMany: The radio replaces any contact without a star, even one you write to or sign in to. A star keeps these on it.
removedPage.empty: Nothing removed. Contacts taken off the radio are kept here for 90 days, to be put back.
removedPage.note: Kept for 90 days. Chats with these nodes stay in Chats.
notOnRadio.title: Not on your radio.
notOnRadio.radioDropped: The radio let {name} go, likely when its memory was full.
notOnRadio.takenOffOn: {name} was taken off the radio on {date}.
notOnRadio.notKept: The radio heard {name} but didn't keep it.
notOnRadio.cannotReach: Messages can't go to {name}, and theirs won't reach you.
cleanUp.title: Clean up

cleanUp.notHeardOver.one: Not heard for over {count} day. You can put any of them back from Settings › Contacts › Removed.
cleanUp.notHeardOver.other: Not heard for over {count} days. You can put any of them back from Settings › Contacts › Removed.

cleanUp.allHeard.one: Every node was heard in the last {count} day.
cleanUp.allHeard.other: Every node was heard in the last {count} days.

cleanUp.chatWarnOne: {name}'s direct messages won't reach you until they advertise again.
cleanUp.chatWarnMany: Direct messages from the chats picked won't reach you until they advertise again.
